<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 180.0423, which in positive mode corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.035 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) suggests about 12 carbons. Searching for formulas that match the exact mass within a few millidaltons and give an integer double‑bond equivalent leads to C₁₂H₅NO (exact monoisotopic mass = 179.0371 Da, within 2 mDa of the observed mass). This formula also yields an integer DBE (11) and fits the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H5NO</final_answer>
